next_step: Closed - lost to LocalCloudHealth due to EU-only residency requirement; move to churn/watchlist
notes:
SUMMARY: Procurement concluded vendor selection 2026-01. Primary blocker: regulatory requirement to keep all patient PII and derived vectors in EU-only region. Helix legal/security insisted on contract language + tech guarantee: no data egress from EU and regional-only control plane. Redwood offering (hosted + private) could not commit to EU-only runtime for their POC footprint — required cross-region fallback for high-availability. Outcome: they signed with LocalCloudHealth (on-prem + EU cloud) that provided EU-only tenancy.

CRM style call notes / snippets:
- 2025-11-03 initial discovery call (Maya): heavy emphasis on GDPR & national regulator (DE) guidance. "We cannot have data leave EU boundaries under any circumstance." Wants SSO + audit logs.
- 2025-12-10 product demo (Rafael): showed Dedicated + Private options. Good reaction to batching/cost controls. Concerns: Redwood console control plane hosted in multi-region by default.
- 2025-12-17 security deep-dive with compliance team: asked for architecture diagram with region isolation. Rafael to provide network diagram + KMS design.
- 2026-01-18 security review call: Helix legal insisted on contract clause for EU-only region + penalties. Redwood legal said clause needs PM approval; architecture change required.
- 2026-01-25 procurement call: internal champion (Lead ML Eng, Petra) put under headcount freeze; champion later left to competitor.
- 2026-01-27 final negotiation: LocalCloudHealth committed to dedicated EU-only tenancy and signed; Helix notified AE.

QUOTES / SOUND-BITES:
- "We have zero-tolerance for any cross-border processing — regulator will audit." (Helix CISO)
- "The fallback routing is a deal-breaker; if tokens can be routed outside EU for HA, we can't accept it." (Head of Legal)

ACTION ITEMS / PAST NEXT STEPS (for Redwood):
- Provided regional architecture (drive link) and draft SLA addendum - 2025-12-20.
- Legal escalated to Product + Infra for feasibility of EU-only control plane - closed for now.
- Recommend: add to churn/watchlist; nurture for future Private on-prem bundle or certified EU-only region offering.
